test_pixel_control_rewards: test the pixel_control_rewards function to compute pseudo rewards from pixel observation sequences
test_feature_control_rewards_feature: test the feature_control_rewards function with cumulant_type='feature' to return features as rewards
test_feature_control_rewards_absolute_ch: test the feature_control_rewards function with cumulant_type='absolute_change' to compute absolute differences between consecutive timesteps
test_feature_control_rewards_potential: test the feature_control_rewards function with cumulant_type='potential' to compute discounted potential-based rewards
